source.transport: Downloaded over HTTPS with normal TLS certificate verification; the dedicated workflow repeats the download and verifies the digest before parsing.
source.license_attribution: ORACC default CC BY-SA 3.0; project-specific terms may differ. Kept separate from corpusjson edition licence metadata.

design.identity: qualified (subproject, Q), with each TF translation_id composed from the qualified document key and TEI unit id
design.alignment: inclusive source line range resolves against ordered M3 lines; oslots is the union of current SlotPlan.section_slots for those lines
design.single_line: explicit xtr:ref maps to that one source line; missing/ambiguous ranges are gaps
design.zero_span: synthetic anchors contribute position only; no neighbouring-slot borrowing or fabricated text
design.markup_and_notes: plain text and canonical inner markup are preserved separately; explicit TEI notes remain linked to their containing unit
design.gaps: unaligned source units, unresolved line refs, and TEI documents missing from the build are counted with source-grounded detail

verification.focused_translation_tests: 8 passed, including parser, archive digest, alignment, synthetic anchors, and explicit gap behavior.
verification.real_source_gate: Passed against the pinned official archive: 1,639 TEI documents, 9,301 source units, 6,792 aligned units, and 2,509 explicit alignment gaps.
verification.generated_reference: Generated from the full source build; docs drift check passes after removing one stale feature page absent from current TF metadata.
